name: Adam
verse: The Lord God formed the man of dust from the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life.
fact: The first human, given the task of naming every living creature in the garden.

name: Noah
verse: Noah walked with God.
fact: Built the ark over decades in obedience, though rain had never fallen on the earth before.

name: Abraham
verse: Go from your country and your kindred and your father's house to the land that I will show you.
fact: Left everything familiar at God's call and became known as the father of many nations.

name: Sarah
verse: By faith Sarah herself received power to conceive, even when she was past the age.
fact: Laughed at God's promise of a son, then named him Isaac, meaning 'laughter.'

name: Joseph
verse: You meant evil against me, but God meant it for good.
fact: Sold into slavery by his brothers, he rose to become second only to Pharaoh in Egypt.

name: Moses
verse: I AM WHO I AM.
fact: Led Israel out of slavery in Egypt and received the Ten Commandments at Sinai.

name: Miriam
verse: Sing to the Lord, for he has triumphed gloriously.
fact: Watched over baby Moses in the Nile and later led Israel's women in worship.

name: Joshua
verse: Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.
fact: Led Israel into the Promised Land and saw the walls of Jericho fall.

name: Deborah
verse: She sent and summoned Barak... and said to him, 'Has not the Lord, the God of Israel, commanded you?'
fact: A prophet and judge who led Israel to victory during a time of oppression.

name: Ruth
verse: Where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay. Your people shall be my people, and your God my God.
fact: A Moabite widow whose loyalty and faith led her into the lineage of King David.

name: Hannah
verse: I have asked for him from the Lord.
fact: Prayed years for a son, then gave that son, Samuel, back to serve the Lord.

name: David
verse: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
fact: A shepherd boy who defeated Goliath and became Israel's greatest king.

name: Solomon
verse: Give your servant therefore an understanding mind.
fact: Asked God for wisdom rather than riches, and became renowned for both.

name: Elijah
verse: And after the fire the sound of a low whisper.
fact: Called down fire from heaven on Mount Carmel, then heard God in a gentle whisper.

name: Elisha
verse: Please let there be a double portion of your spirit on me.
fact: Succeeded Elijah and performed many miracles of healing and provision.

name: Isaiah
verse: Here am I! Send me.
fact: A prophet whose writings foretold the coming Messiah in striking detail.

name: Jeremiah
verse: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you.
fact: Known as the 'weeping prophet' for his sorrow over Jerusalem's judgment.

name: Daniel
verse: My God sent his angel and shut the lions' mouths.
fact: Remained faithful in prayer even under threat of death, and was protected in the lions' den.

name: Esther
verse: For such a time as this.
fact: A Jewish queen in Persia whose courage saved her people from destruction.

name: Jonah
verse: I will look again toward your holy temple.
fact: Ran from God's call, was swallowed by a great fish, and later preached to Nineveh.

name: Mary
verse: Let it be to me according to your word.
fact: A young woman whose humble obedience made her the mother of Jesus.

name: John the Baptist
verse: Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
fact: Prepared the way for Jesus, baptizing in the wilderness and calling people to repentance.

name: Peter
verse: You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.
fact: A fisherman called to be a disciple, who denied Jesus and was later restored to lead the early church.

name: Mary Magdalene
verse: I have seen the Lord.
fact: The first person to see the risen Jesus and to announce His resurrection.

name: Paul
verse: I can do all things through him who strengthens me.
fact: Once a persecutor of Christians, he was transformed on the road to Damascus and became the church's great missionary.

name: Timothy
verse: Let no one despise you for your youth.
fact: A young pastor mentored by Paul, entrusted with leading and strengthening churches.

name: Lydia
verse: The Lord opened her heart to pay attention to what was said by Paul.
fact: A businesswoman and the first recorded European convert, who opened her home to the early church.

name: Stephen
verse: Lord, do not hold this sin against them.
fact: The first Christian martyr, who prayed for forgiveness for those stoning him.
